name: Jobber
category: Field service software for small and growing home service businesses
whyTheyWin: Cheap and easy to start, and well known in lawn care and cleaning. Often the first software a shop buys, so we meet it most in switch deals.

facts.fact: Founded in 2011 by Sam Pillar and Forrest Zeisler; headquartered in Edmonton, Alberta.

name: ServiceTitan
category: Field service platform built for larger residential and commercial contractors
whyTheyWin: Seen as the platform serious contractors grow into. Wins when an owner plans to scale well past 20 techs and wants deep reporting, call-center, and price book tools, and will accept a longer setup.

facts.fact: Began trading on Nasdaq under the ticker TTAN on December 12, 2024.
